newsitem.title: USA: General Signal sees better 2nd half results.
newsitem.headline: General Signal sees better 2nd half results.

text.p: General Signal Corp said Monday that it expected improved results in the second half of the year despite slightly disappointing second quarter earnings of $0.68 a share.

"Second quarter earnings, though modestly off plan, were within consensus expectations. This is gratifying, given the company's weak first quarter results of 47 cents per share," said Michael Lockhart, chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.

"Orders for the month of June showed the best percentage improvement over the year-ago period so far this year, up more than five percent, and we expect this improvement to continue in the second half," he added.
Lockhart also said that "we remain optimistic that second half results will be consistent" with Wall Street expectations.
The First Call consensus estimates project that General Signal will earn $0.80 a share in the third quarter and $0.95 a share in the fourth quarter.
In separate news, the company said it plans to repurchase up to $150 million of its common shares.
General Signal makes products serving the process control, electrical control, and industrial technology industries.
